title: Navigation shell with visible structure and active states
asA: user moving between areas of the application
iWant: persistent navigation that always shows where I am and where I can go
soThat: I never feel lost or have to use the back button to orient myself

acceptanceCriteria.description: Top navigation renders on every route from the route inventory; sections the signed-in user cannot access are absent, not disabled.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the top navigation is present and reflects the route inventory for the current user

acceptanceCriteria.description: The navigation item for the current section carries a visible active state and aria-current="page" on the exact match.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a route within a navigation section
acceptanceCriteria.then: that section's item is visually active and exposes aria-current

acceptanceCriteria.description: Side navigation, where the project declares secondary structure, collapses below 1024 into an accessible disclosure pattern rather than disappearing.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project with declared secondary navigation
acceptanceCriteria.then: secondary navigation is reachable via a toggle with an accessible name and state

acceptanceCriteria.description: Navigation renders identically from the same inventory data on every route; no route ships a bespoke variant of the shell.
acceptanceCriteria.then: navigation structure and behaviour are identical except for active states

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every navigation link is a real link with an href, supporting open-in-new-tab and middle-click, not a click-handler-only element.
acceptanceCriteria.then: it exposes an href and opens correctly in a new tab
